title: brachiaria leucacrantha
intro: Brachiaria leucacrantha, commonly known as White Panic Grass, is a type of tropical grass belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antidiabetic, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Brachiaria leucacrantha are attributed to its ability to modulate oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
